Trade food with people you can trust, on one record from quote to payment

T57 exists to make food trade verified, connected and financeable for every business that grows, raises, catches, processes or sells food.

The challenge

A single food trade still needs eight separate services

The world spends about $2.22 trillion a year importing food (FAO, 2025 forecast). Yet finding a buyer, checking them, agreeing terms, arranging finance, insurance, inspection, shipping and customs each come with their own paperwork, delays and risk. Banks rejected 41% of SME trade finance applications in 2025, part of a $2.5 trillion global gap (ADB, 2026).

Trust

Buyers and sellers cannot easily tell who is real, who owns the goods and who is only passing them on.

Fragmentation

Quotes, contracts, inspection reports, finance and shipping documents live in different inboxes and systems, so details get lost or changed.

Access to finance

Lenders cannot see a clean, verified history of a trade, so good businesses are turned away or charged more.

    FAQ

    Questions we hear most

    What is T57?

    T57 is AI-native digital trade infrastructure for the food industry. It brings verification, quotes, contracts, finance access, insurance, inspection and logistics onto one trade record for verified members.

    Who can join T57?

    Any business in the food chain can apply, including farmers, fishers, processors, manufacturers, brands, traders, importers, wholesalers, supermarkets and HoReCa buyers. Every member is verified before trading.

    Does T57 lend money or hold my funds?

    No. T57 does not lend, hold client funds, own goods or provide transport. Finance, escrow, insurance and logistics are provided by licensed partners through the platform.

    Which countries does T57 cover?

    T57's founding markets are Saudi Arabia, the UAE, India, Malaysia and Türkiye. Businesses in other countries can apply for membership online.

    How does T57 use AI?

    AI helps with matching, risk checks, document preparation and forecasting. People make the final decisions, and any adverse decision is reviewed by a person.

    Good deals should not fail for lack of trust or finance.

    The challenge

    Every party sees only part of the deal

    A shipment of rice or dates can pass through a farmer, a cooperative, a processor, a trader, an importer, a bank, an insurer, an inspector, a freight forwarder and a customs authority. Each sees only part of the deal, so trust is rebuilt at every step and risk builds up in the gaps. Around 13.3% of food is lost between harvest and retail (FAO, 2023), and 645 million people still went hungry in 2025 (SOFI, 2026).

    Unknown counterparties

    It is hard to tell producers from intermediaries, or real companies from shell companies.

    Disconnected services

    Finance, insurance, inspection and logistics are bought separately, with no shared view of the trade.

    Uneven access

    Smaller producers and SMEs struggle to reach buyers, lenders and fair terms that larger players take for granted.

    Use case · Illustrative example

    Indian rice reaches a Saudi distributor through a Riyadh trader

    A Riyadh trading house agrees to supply basmati rice from an Indian processor to a Saudi distributor. On T57, all three firms hold a T57 Passport and role label, so each knows who controls the goods. The trader sends one deal file to several licensed lenders, who compete to fund the purchase. Inspection in India, freight and Saudi clearance are booked through partners. The processor, trader, distributor, lender and inspector all work from the same trade record, so documents match and payment releases when agreed milestones are met.

    Why T57

    Trust in food trade should be built once and shared, not rebuilt at every step.

    A members-only trade club

    T57 is not an open marketplace. Every member is verified and labelled by role, so the people you meet on T57 are who they say they are.

    Institutional backing

    Who can join T57?

    Any business or institution in the food chain can apply, from farmers and fishers to processors, brands, traders, importers, supermarkets, HoReCa buyers, lenders, insurers, service providers and government bodies.

    Why does T57 verify every member?

    Verification lets every member trade with confidence. It also gives lenders and insurers the trusted information they need to support a trade.

    Can individuals join T57?

    T57 is built for registered businesses and institutions. Individual farmers can join through a cooperative or producer organization.

    The problem

    The food trade is drowning in data yet starving for insight

    The global food trade runs on the illusion of efficiency. Platforms today focus on price discovery and container movements while ignoring the real bottlenecks: fragmented data, a lack of convenient funding, chronic paperwork and policy blind spots.

    Governments see too late

    They see disconnected snapshots of demand and supply months after the fact, with no live view of waste, surpluses and shocks across borders.

    Traders work blind

    PDFs, emails and static directories obscure origin, quality and risk, while duplicate audits and changing standards push compliance costs up and price out smallholders.

    Producers can't get funded

    Small farmers, cooperatives and agri-SMEs face a multi-trillion-dollar financing gap, while logistics, finance and agronomy are still treated as separate worlds.

    Why T57

    Built where food security, trade and trust meet

    A shared digital corridor

    Farmers, FPOs, governments, traders and enterprises share one corridor for sourcing, compliance, financing, logistics and settlement, combining verified counterparties, policy-ready infrastructure and real-time market intelligence.

    Built with the institutions that shape food security

    T57 works with the Islamic Organization for Food Security (IOFS), an OIC institution, under a 10-year memorandum of understanding, and has signed an MoU with ASEAN. That makes T57 a policy-aligned corridor where governments, cooperatives and enterprises can trade with confidence.

    FAQ

    Common questions

    How is T57 different from other food trade platforms?

    T57 is an AI-native ecosystem, working with IOFS and ASEAN, that brings trade, finance, logistics and policy-grade data together on one verified platform.

    Why do the IOFS and ASEAN partnerships matter to me as a trader?

    They translate into faster onboarding, clearer rules of origin and better access to tenders and sovereign buyers, because T57 aligns with the institutions that set food security and trade priorities.

    Does T57 only serve governments and institutions?

    No. The same rails that serve ministries and multilaterals also serve farmers, cooperatives, SMEs and enterprises, giving every player, big and small, access to verified markets and trusted counterparties.

    Why T57 · Join the club

    Trade only with verified members.

    Verified food-trade club that matches vetted counterparties, reducing fraud and defaults across every global agri transaction.

    Apply for membershipSee how it works

    What you get with T57

    1. CounterpartiesWithout T57: Anonymous profilesWith T57: Verified T57 ID and trust score
    2. Replies to RFQsWithout T57: Incomplete, not seriousWith T57: Serious, qualified offers
    3. RiskWithout T57: Found out too lateWith T57: Visible before you trade

    TodayWith T57

    Finance, escrow and insurance come from licensed partners.

    T57's club membership replaces anonymous, open listings with a curated, fully verified trade club, using a process that goes beyond a standard business-registry check to ensure compliance and close trades faster.

    The problem

    Open marketplaces: who is real?

    Without a club-based model, food and agri trade is opaque and unreliable. Traditionally, buyers have posted RFQs on marketplaces and waited days, only to receive incomplete or non-serious responses, and never knowing who is behind a profile. Sellers have struggled to distinguish genuine demand from trial inquiries, resulting in delayed or failed payments that have eroded margins and trust.

    T57 changes this by determining each member's trust score through a blockchain-enabled process that evaluates document quality, business legitimacy, compliance and risk, on-field verification, trade history, financial stability, reference response, partner relationship, ecosystem reputation, and overall reputation. The evaluation is used to generate a verified T57 ID with appropriate badges and a score, giving farmers and producers, cooperatives and FPOs, buyers and importers, sellers and exporters, traders and aggregators, manufacturers and enterprises, food processors, service providers, financiers and investors, partners and collaborators, and governments and regulators a stronger basis for reducing counterparty and transaction risk.

    How it works

    From application to trusted trade

    1. 01

      Curated membership built on trust scoring

      Every applicant wishing to join T57 is assessed on document quality, business legitimacy, compliance and risk, on-field verification, trade history, financial stability, reference responses, partner relationships, ecosystem reputation, and overall reputation.

    2. 02

      Verified profiles, with badges, score, and risk visibility

      Once admitted, each member's profile reflects the outcomes of the trust-scoring process through a verified ID badge and a score that signals strengths across a variety of factors important to other members of T57.

    3. 03

      Trusted matching with lower execution risk

      Because T57 user profiles are backed by structured trust scores rather than self-reported claims, matching occurs between counterparties with established verification status.

    What makes it different

    Built for trust, not just listings

    Trust-scored identity instead of basic registrationT57 does not stop at account creation or standard verification. It uses a blockchain-enabled process that goes beyond standard registration checks to evaluate ten trust factors and issue a T57 ID with badges and a score, enabling members to quickly assess whether a counterparty is likely to be legitimate, stable, and dependable.
    Risk reduction for every key food-trade participantThe model is designed to help members make better decisions. Instead of relying on incomplete listings or unverified claims, members see structured trust signals grounded in verification.
    A stronger trust layer for trade relationshipsBy combining verified inputs, T57 creates a relationship infrastructure that supports more confident onboarding and a lower exposure to fraud and default.

    Use case · Illustrative example

    When trusted capacity really matters

    A mid-sized, export-focused food processor in North Africa seeks to bid on a multi-year government tender for fortified wheat-based products but cannot, on its own, meet the required annual volume or the stringent delivery performance clauses. Through T57 Club Membership, the processor can access a set of pre-verified upstream mills and aggregators with documented volume histories, financial standing, and quality records.

    Using this visibility, the processor forms a virtual consortium of club members whose combined, verified capacity meets the tender requirement, enabling a credible bid backed by traceable supply, predictable lead times, and known payment behavior. Because all parties are already KYC/KYB-cleared and trade on the same platform, the government buyer gains greater confidence in the continuity of supply and compliance, and participating members gain access to high-quality demand that would be inaccessible in an open, uncurated marketplace.

    Why T57

    T57 is built to operate at the intersection of food systems, finance, technology, and regulation, where the cost of a single failed shipment or a fraudulent counterparty can cascade across entire value chains.

    Disciplined approach builds trust

    Trust is the real operating layer of global food commerce, and T57 is designed to make that trust visible. By converting verified evidence into a T57 ID, using a multi-factor verification process, T57 helps every core participant build trading relationships on a more credible foundation.

    FAQ

    Common questions

    How does the T57 trust score help farmers and producers, cooperatives, and FPOs reduce risk?

    The trust score helps these groups assess whether prospective buyers, aggregators, processors, or service partners have the legitimacy, financial stability, trade history, and relationship strength needed to support dependable transactions. This reduces the risk of engaging with weak or opaque counterparties.

    Why is the T57 ID useful for financiers and investors, partners, collaborators, governments, and regulators?

    The T57 ID provides these stakeholders with a structured view of whether an organization has been verified across key trust factors, including compliance, field validation, references, and ecosystem reputation. That makes it easier to evaluate risk and engage with businesses whose credentials are supported by a more advanced process than standard marketplace profiles or basic business identifiers.

    WHY T57 · DISCOVER AND MATCH

    One request. Comparable quotes. One contract.

    Get comparable quotes from verified suppliers, and turn the best one into a contract.

    Post your first RFQSee how it works

    What you get with T57

    1. EnquiriesWithout T57: Email, WhatsApp, brokersWith T57: One structured RFQ
    2. QuotesWithout T57: Mixed formats, unknown suppliersWith T57: Like-for-like bids, verified suppliers
    3. ContractWithout T57: Retyped by handWith T57: Generated from the accepted quote

    TodayWith T57

    Finance, escrow and insurance come from licensed partners.

    T57 solves the slow, scattered way food is quoted today, for buyers who need the right supply and sellers who want serious enquiries.

    The problem

    Quotes in different formats, from suppliers you cannot check

    Most food trade still starts with an enquiry sent by email, WhatsApp or a broker. Quotes come back in different formats, currencies and Incoterms, often from suppliers the buyer cannot check. Specifications get lost in long message threads, and the terms finally agreed are retyped into a contract by hand. Buyers waste days comparing offers that are not like for like. Sellers waste time answering enquiries that were never serious.

    How it works

    Request → Bid → Award

    1. 01

      Request

      A verified buyer sets product, grade, quantity, packaging, Incoterms, destination and delivery window once.

    2. 02

      Bid

      Verified suppliers matched to the request submit quotes in the same structure, so price and terms line up.

    3. 03

      Award

      The buyer compares bids side by side, accepts one, and the contract is generated from the accepted quote.

    What makes it different

    Built for trust, not just listings

    Only verified biddersEvery supplier holds a T57 Passport and a role label (owner-producer, processor, trader or intermediary). Buyers know who they are dealing with before they read a price.
    Like-for-like comparisonStructured quotes and recent price data sit side by side. Buyers can see which offer is strongest and how it compares with the market.
    From quote to contract with no retypingThe accepted quote becomes the contract, with the same product, price, quantity and terms. Both parties work from one trade record from the first message.

    Use case · Illustrative example

    Dubai importer sources frozen poultry from Türkiye

    A Dubai food importer needs 10 containers of halal frozen poultry for a hotel group contract. It posts one RFQ on T57. Within days, five verified processors in Türkiye and Brazil submit structured bids. The importer filters for owner-producers and processors, compares price, payment terms and delivery dates side by side, and awards the contract to a processor in Türkiye. The contract, inspection booking and LC request all start from the same record.

    Why T57

    We believe that a good trade starts with a clear request and an honest answer.

    Verified from the first message

    T57 is a members-only trade club. Bids come only from members who have passed business, identity and compliance checks.

    AI advises, people decide

    AI suggests which suppliers to invite and flags unusual prices or terms. The buyer decides who wins.

    FAQ

    Common questions

    Who can respond to an RFQ on T57?

    Only verified members whose products, capacity and markets match the request. Buyers can also invite specific suppliers.

    Can sellers see each other's bids?

    No. Each bid is visible only to the buyer, which keeps pricing fair and confidential.

    WHY T57 · DISCOVER AND MATCH

    A trade desk for every food business.

    A full trade desk for every member, with AI doing the groundwork and people deciding.

    Book a Trade Desk demoSee how it works

    What you get with T57

    1. MatchingWithout T57: Agents and guessworkWith T57: Ranked, verified counterparties
    2. PricingWithout T57: UnclearWith T57: Recent price data on every quote
    3. ComplianceWithout T57: Gaps found at the borderWith T57: Screening before the deal moves

    TodayWith T57

    Finance, escrow and insurance come from licensed partners.

    T57 gives every member the tools of a bank or trading-house trade desk, so smaller businesses can find, price, agree and check deals with confidence.

    The problem

    One person doing sourcing, pricing and compliance

    Large trading houses and banks run trade desks: teams that find counterparties, check prices, draft contracts and screen every party for sanctions. Most food SMEs have none of this. One person handles sourcing, pricing, paperwork and compliance across email, spreadsheets and PDFs. Deals are slower, mistakes are common, and compliance gaps can stop a shipment at the border or a payment at the bank.

    How it works

    Match → Price and agree → Check

    1. 01

      Match

      The Trade Desk ranks verified counterparties by product, volume, corridor and track record.

    2. 02

      Price and agree

      Recent price data supports your quote or counter-offer, and the accepted quote becomes the contract.

    3. 03

      Check

      Every counterparty is screened against sanctions and watchlists, and documents are checked for completeness before the deal moves on.

    What makes it different

    Built for trust, not just listings

    One desk for the whole dealMatching, price data, contracts and compliance screening sit on the same trade record, not in four tools.
    Built for SMEsMembers get the groundwork a large trading house would do for them, without hiring a desk team.
    People behind the AIAI ranks, extracts and flags, and T57's trade desk team reviews cases that need a human eye. Every adverse decision is reviewed by a person.

    Use case · Illustrative example

    Kochi spice exporter wins its first Gulf buyer

    A family spice exporter in Kochi has always sold through agents. On T57, the Trade Desk suggests three verified distributors in Riyadh and Jeddah that buy cardamom and pepper in matching volumes. Price data shows where the exporter's quote sits against recent trades. When a Jeddah distributor accepts, the contract is generated from the quote, both parties are screened automatically, and a missing phytosanitary certificate is flagged before shipment, not at the port.

    Why T57

    We believe that every food business deserves the same trade support as the largest players.

    AI advises, people decide

    The Trade Desk suggests and checks. You make the call, and any adverse decision about a member is reviewed by a person.

    Compliance built in

    Sanctions and watchlist screening runs on every counterparty, so compliance happens before a problem, not after.

    FAQ

    Common questions

    Is the Virtual Trade Desk a person or software?

    Both. The Trade Desk is software that matches, prices, drafts and screens, supported by T57's trade desk team for cases that need human review.

    Does the Trade Desk negotiate for me?

    No. It gives you matches, price data and checks. You negotiate and decide.

    See prices, supply and risk by origin before you quote, buy or plan.

    See it in a demoSee how it works

    What you get with T57

    1. PricesWithout T57: Old or second-handWith T57: Prices by origin, as they move
    2. Supply riskWithout T57: Learned from the newsWith T57: Supply status by origin
    3. ForecastsWithout T57: Black boxesWith T57: Forecasts you can question

    TodayWith T57

    Finance, escrow and insurance come from licensed partners.

    T57 solves the information gap that leaves food buyers and sellers pricing blind, by putting market data and AI forecasts inside the trade itself.

    The problem

    Quoting and buying blind

    Food prices can move fast and without warning. When the Strait of Hormuz closed in early 2026, the World Bank's fertilizer price index rose 44% and urea prices 82% between February and April (ICC, August 2026). FAO warned that 20–45% of key agrifood inputs for some markets pass through the strait. Large traders pay for market terminals and analysts. Most food SMEs rely on calls to contacts and last month's invoices, so they quote too low, buy too late or miss a shortage until it hits.

    How it works

    Watch → Read the signal → Act

    1. 01

      Watch

      Follow the products and origins you trade, with recent prices from the market and from T57 trades.

    2. 02

      Read the signal

      See supply status by origin (surplus, stable, at risk or shortage) and AI forecasts of price and supply.

    3. 03

      Act

      Use the data to set a quote, time a purchase or post an RFQ, without leaving the platform.

    What makes it different

    Built for trust, not just listings

    Data where you tradePrices and supply signals sit next to your RFQs and quotes, not in a separate subscription.
    Supply status by originA simple surplus-to-shortage view helps buyers switch origins before disruption reaches them.
    Forecasts you can questionAI forecasts show the inputs behind them, and people make the decisions.

    Use case · Illustrative example

    Jeddah rice importer switches origin ahead of a shortage

    A Jeddah rice importer normally buys from one origin. On T57, the supply view moves that origin from stable to at risk after an export restriction is announced, and the forecast shows prices rising. The importer posts an RFQ to verified suppliers in two other origins, compares bids against recent price data and secures supply for the next quarter before prices rise.

    Why T57

    We believe that better information should not be a privilege of the largest traders.

    AI advises, people decide

    Forecasts and supply signals inform your decisions. They never make them for you.

    Built for food security

    The same data helps governments and institutions see supply risks early, through T57's food-security view.

    FAQ

    Common questions

    Where does T57's price data come from?

    From public market sources and anonymized, aggregated trade data on T57. No individual member's prices are shared.

    Can I use the data without trading on T57?

    Market intelligence is part of T57 membership and is built to support trading on the platform.

    More in Why T57

    Why T57 Trade FinanceHow it worksWhat's differentUse caseFAQ

    WHY T57 · FINANCE THE TRADE

    One deal file. Several lenders compete.

    One verified deal file, several lenders competing to fund your food trade.

    Request trade financeSee how it works

    What you get with T57

    1. ApplicationsWithout T57: One bank at a timeWith T57: One file, many lenders
    2. EvidenceWithout T57: Paper, hard to trustWith T57: Verified trade evidence
    3. RepaymentWithout T57: Separate from the tradeWith T57: Repaid from the trade itself

    TodayWith T57

    Finance, escrow and insurance come from licensed partners.

    T57 solves the finance gap for food SMEs by turning every trade into a verified, documented deal that licensed lenders can assess and fund.

    The problem

    Weeks of separate applications

    The global trade finance gap reached $2.5 trillion in 2025, and banks rejected 41% of SME trade finance applications (ADB, January 2026). Food SMEs are hit hardest. Each bank asks for the same documents in a different format, takes weeks to respond and often says no because it cannot see a clean record of the trade. So producers and traders fund deals from their own cash, turn down orders or accept expensive informal credit.

    How it works

    Request → Compare → Fund and repay

    1. 01

      Request

      From an accepted trade, send a finance request built from your verified deal file: Passport, contract, counterparties and documents.

    2. 02

      Compare

      Licensed banks and finance companies, including Islamic finance providers, review the same file and compete with offers.

    3. 03

      Fund and repay

      Accept the best offer. At settlement, the end buyer's payment goes into escrow and repays the lender automatically.

    What makes it different

    Built for trust, not just listings

    One file, many lendersYou prepare one request, not one per bank, and lenders compete for your trade.
    Verified evidenceLenders see a verified business, a contract generated from an accepted quote and a full trade record, which makes it easier to say yes.
    Self-liquidating structureRepayment comes from the trade itself through escrow, which lowers the risk for lenders and the burden for you.

    Use case · Illustrative example

    Riyadh trader funds an Indian rice shipment

    A Riyadh trading house has a confirmed order from a Saudi distributor for basmati rice from an Indian processor. Its own capital is tied up in other shipments. It sends one finance request from the trade record to several licensed lenders and accepts the best offer. The exporter is paid at shipment through an LC. When the distributor accepts delivery and pays into escrow, the lender is repaid automatically and the balance goes to the trader.

    Why T57

    We believe that a sound food trade should be financeable, whatever the size of the business behind it.

    T57 does not lend

    Finance is provided by licensed banks and finance companies, who make their own credit decisions. T57 provides the verified record and the workflow.

    AI advises, people decide

    AI helps prepare and check the deal file. Lenders decide, and any adverse decision by T57 about a member is reviewed by a person.

    FAQ

    Common questions

    Does T57 provide the finance?

    No. T57 does not lend or hold client funds. It sends your verified deal file to licensed lenders, who decide whether to fund the trade and on what terms.

    What kinds of finance can I request?

    Pre-shipment and post-shipment finance, receivables finance and letters of credit, through participating banks and finance companies, including Shariah-compliant options.

    More in Why T57

    Why T57 Digital Asset-Based FundingHow it worksWhat's differentUse caseFAQ

    WHY T57 · FINANCE THE TRADE

    Turn trade documents into fundable assets.

    Turn verified trade documents into digital assets that funders can trust and finance.

    Talk to usSee how it works

    What you get with T57

    1. DocumentsWithout T57: Paper, easy to duplicateWith T57: One document, one owner
    2. Link to tradeWithout T57: Hard to proveWith T57: Linked to a verified trade
    3. FundersWithout T57: A few local banksWith T57: A wider pool of funders

    TodayWith T57

    Finance, escrow and insurance come from licensed partners.

    T57 solves the problem of trade documents that can be copied, faked or pledged twice, by recording them as unique, tokenized digital assets on a tamper-evident ledger.

    The problem

    Paper documents can be copied and pledged twice

    Trade finance still runs on paper. A bill of lading, warehouse receipt or invoice can be scanned, altered or used as collateral with more than one lender. Lenders know this, so they ask for more checks, more time and more security, and smaller businesses are often refused. The goods are real and the trade is sound, but the documents behind them are hard to trust.

    How it works

    Verify → Tokenize → Fund

    1. 01

      Verify

      A trade document, such as an invoice, warehouse receipt or bill of lading, is checked against the verified trade record.

    2. 02

      Tokenize

      The document is recorded as a unique digital token (often called an NFT) on a tamper-evident ledger, linked to its owner and the trade.

    3. 03

      Fund

      Licensed lenders and investors can see the token's history and fund against it. The token cannot be pledged twice, and its status updates as the trade moves.

    What makes it different

    Built for trust, not just listings

    One document, one ownerEach token is unique and traceable, so the same invoice or receipt cannot be financed twice.
    Linked to real tradeTokens are created only from documents on a verified T57 trade record, never from unverified paper.
    Wider fundingVerified, traceable documents can attract banks, finance companies and, where the law allows, institutional investors.

    Use case · Illustrative example

    Johor palm oil processor finances stock against a tokenized warehouse receipt

    A palm oil processor in Johor holds stock in a bonded warehouse while it waits for a buyer contract. On T57, its warehouse receipt is verified against the trade record and recorded as a unique digital token. A licensed lender can see that the receipt is genuine, unpledged and linked to real stock, and advances working capital against it. When the goods are sold, the token's status updates and the lender is repaid from the sale.

    Why T57

    We believe that a real asset should be easy to prove and fair to finance.

    Lawful by design

    Digital-asset funding is offered only where the law allows, through licensed partners who make their own decisions. T57 does not lend or hold client funds.

    AI advises, people decide

    AI checks documents for completeness and consistency. Every adverse decision is reviewed by a person.

    FAQ

    Common questions

    Is this cryptocurrency?

    No. A tokenized trade document is a digital record of a real asset, such as an invoice or warehouse receipt. It is not a currency.

    Which documents can be tokenized?

    Trade documents on a verified T57 trade record, such as invoices, warehouse receipts and bills of lading, where local law recognizes electronic trade documents.

    More in Why T57

    Why T57 eLC in 15 MinutesHow it worksWhat's differentUse caseFAQ

    WHY T57 · EXECUTE AND SETTLE

    Letters of credit, built from your contract.

    Electronic letters of credit, issued in about 15 minutes once your application is approved.

    Apply for an eLCSee how it works

    What you get with T57

    1. ApplicationWithout T57: Retyped from the contractWith T57: Built from the contract
    2. IssuanceWithout T57: Days of back-and-forthWith T57: About 15 minutes after approval
    3. DocumentsWithout T57: Paper presentationWith T57: Digital presentation

    TodayWith T57

    Finance, escrow and insurance come from licensed partners.

    T57 solves the slow, paper-heavy letter of credit process by building the LC application from your verified trade record and sending it to partner banks digitally.

    The problem

    Paper letters of credit: slow and error-prone

    The letter of credit is one of the oldest and safest ways to pay for goods across borders, but it is slow. Applications are filled in by hand, documents are couriered between banks, and small differences between the LC and the shipping documents lead to rejections and delays. For food, where goods spoil and prices move, every day spent waiting is a cost. Many smaller exporters and importers avoid LCs altogether and take on more risk instead.

    How it works

    Apply from the trade → Approve → Issue and present

    1. 01

      Apply from the trade

      The LC application is built from the accepted contract and verified counterparties, so terms match from the start.

    2. 02

      Approve

      A partner bank reviews the application against the verified trade record and approves it under its own credit rules.

    3. 03

      Issue and present

      Once approved, the electronic LC is targeted to be issued in about 15 minutes. Shipping and inspection documents are presented digitally against it.

    What makes it different

    Built for trust, not just listings

    Built from the contractThe LC uses the same product, price, quantity and terms as the contract, which reduces the mismatches that cause discrepancies.
    Digital presentationDocuments move electronically on the trade record instead of by courier, where the law recognizes electronic trade documents.
    Linked to finance and escrowThe LC can work alongside trade finance and escrow on the same record, so payment, funding and delivery stay in step.

    Use case · Illustrative example

    Mersin citrus exporter ships to Dammam with an eLC

    A citrus exporter in Mersin agrees a contract with a verified Dammam importer for the winter season. The importer applies for an LC on T57, built from the accepted contract. Its partner bank approves the application, and the electronic LC is issued shortly afterwards. The exporter ships with confidence, inspection and shipping documents are presented digitally, and the exporter is paid on compliant presentation.

    Why T57

    We believe that a safe way to pay should also be a fast one.

    Banks decide, T57 connects

    Letters of credit are issued by licensed partner banks under their own rules. T57 provides the verified record and the digital workflow.

    AI advises, people decide

    AI checks documents for discrepancies before presentation. Banks make the decisions.

    FAQ

    Common questions

    What does "15 minutes" mean?

    It is the target time for a partner bank to issue the electronic LC after your application has been approved. Approval itself follows the bank's own credit process.

    Does T57 issue letters of credit?

    No. Letters of credit are issued by licensed partner banks. T57 prepares the application from your trade record and connects you to them.

    More in Why T57

    Why T57 Escrow PaymentsHow it worksWhat's differentUse caseFAQ

    WHY T57 · EXECUTE AND SETTLE

    Your money moves only when the goods do.

    Your money moves only when the goods do, with escrow released at agreed milestones.

    Set up an escrow tradeSee how it works

    What you get with T57

    1. PaymentWithout T57: Upfront, at riskWith T57: Held in escrow
    2. ReleaseWithout T57: On trustWith T57: At agreed milestones, with evidence
    3. DisputesWithout T57: Money already goneWith T57: Partial release and dispute triggers

    TodayWith T57

    Finance, escrow and insurance come from licensed partners.

    T57 solves the standoff between buyers who will not pay first and sellers who will not ship first, by holding payment with a licensed escrow partner until agreed milestones are met.

    The problem

    Buyer and seller both carry the risk

    In food trade, someone always carries the risk. If the buyer pays upfront, it risks fraud, short shipment or poor quality. If the seller ships first, it risks late payment or no payment at all. Letters of credit solve this for some deals, but they can be costly and slow for smaller trades and domestic wholesale. Without a trusted middle ground, many good deals never happen.

    How it works

    Agree milestones → Fund escrow → Release

    1. 01

      Agree milestones

      Buyer and seller agree when funds are released, for example on passed inspection, shipment or delivery, as part of the contract.

    2. 02

      Fund escrow

      The buyer pays into escrow with a licensed partner. The seller can see that the money is there before it ships.

    3. 03

      Release

      As each milestone is recorded on the trade record, funds are released, in part or in full. If there is a dispute, release pauses until it is resolved.

    What makes it different

    Built for trust, not just listings

    Milestones tied to evidenceRelease is linked to recorded events, such as an inspection report or delivery confirmation, on the same trade record.
    Partial release and dispute triggersFunds can be released in stages, and a dispute stops release automatically until it is settled.
    Works with financeEscrow can repay a lender at settlement, which makes trade finance safer and easier to get.

    Use case · Illustrative example

    Abu Dhabi hotel group buys produce from a verified UAE farm

    An Abu Dhabi hotel group agrees a three-month supply of fresh vegetables with a verified farm in Al Ain. The group pays each month's order into escrow with T57's licensed partner. When deliveries are confirmed against the order, payment is released to the farm. When one delivery arrives short, the group raises it on the trade record, release for that delivery pauses, and the difference is settled before the rest is paid.

    Why T57

    We believe that neither side of a trade should have to take a leap of faith.

    T57 does not hold your money

    Escrow is provided by licensed partners. T57 records the milestones that trigger release.

    Built for cross-border and domestic trade

    Escrow works for export deals and for domestic wholesale to supermarkets, HoReCa and institutions.

    FAQ

    Common questions

    Who holds the money in escrow?

    A licensed escrow partner. T57 does not hold client funds.

    What happens if there is a dispute?

    Release pauses automatically, and the dispute is handled under the contract and the partner's rules. Release resumes once it is resolved.

    More in Why T57

    Why T57 Alternative PaymentsHow it worksWhat's differentUse caseFAQ

    WHY T57 · EXECUTE AND SETTLE

    More ways to settle, within the law.

    Settle food trades in stablecoins, digital assets or bullion-backed payments, where the law allows.

    Ask about your marketSee how it works

    What you get with T57

    1. MethodsWithout T57: Bank wires onlyWith T57: Stablecoins, digital assets, bullion-backed
    2. ComplianceWithout T57: UnclearWith T57: Through regulated partners
    3. RecordsWithout T57: ScatteredWith T57: One record for every method

    TodayWith T57

    Finance, escrow and insurance come from licensed partners.

    T57 solves the problem of slow, costly or unavailable cross-border payments by offering regulated alternative settlement options alongside traditional bank transfers.

    The problem

    Costly, slow cross-border settlement

    Cross-border payments for food can take days, pass through several correspondent banks and lose value to fees and exchange spreads. In some corridors, access to US dollars is limited or banks have pulled back from smaller businesses altogether. A trade can be agreed, financed and shipped, and still be held up because the payment cannot get through quickly or affordably.

    How it works

    Choose how to settle → Pay through a regulated partner → Record and reconcile

    1. 01

      Choose how to settle

      Buyer and seller agree the settlement method in the contract: bank transfer, stablecoin, another digital asset or a bullion-backed payment.

    2. 02

      Pay through a regulated partner

      The payment is processed by a licensed partner that handles conversion, compliance checks and custody.

    3. 03

      Record and reconcile

      Settlement is recorded on the same trade record as the contract and delivery, so both sides can reconcile at once.

    What makes it different

    Built for trust, not just listings

    More ways to payMembers can choose the method that suits the corridor, the currency and their own rules, not only what their bank offers.
    Compliance firstAlternative payments are offered only where they are lawful, through regulated partners, with the same sanctions and identity checks as every other T57 payment.
    One record for every methodWhatever the payment method, the contract, delivery and settlement sit together on one trade record.

    Use case · Illustrative example

    Lagos importer pays a Malaysian supplier in a stablecoin

    A Lagos food importer agrees to buy palm olein from a verified Malaysian supplier but struggles to obtain US dollars through its bank. Both parties agree in the contract to settle in a dollar stablecoin through T57's regulated payment partner. The importer pays, the partner converts and settles to the supplier's preferred currency, and the payment is recorded against the delivery on the trade record the same day.

    Why T57

    We believe that the way a business pays should never be the reason a good trade fails.

    Regulated partners only

    T57 does not hold client funds or digital assets. Alternative payments are handled by licensed partners in the jurisdictions where they are permitted.

    Your choice, your rules

    Members choose whether to use alternative payments at all. Bank transfers, escrow and letters of credit remain available on every trade.

    FAQ

    Common questions

    Are alternative payments available in every country?

    No. They are offered only where local law allows, through regulated partners. Members in other countries settle through banks, escrow or letters of credit.

    Does T57 hold my crypto or gold?

    No. Custody, conversion and settlement are handled by licensed partners. T57 records the payment on the trade record.

    More in Why T57

    Why T57 Digital BankHow it worksWhat's differentUse caseFAQ

    WHY T57 · EXECUTE AND SETTLE

    Pay and get paid in any currency.

    Hold, pay and settle in any currency, near-instantly, inside your food trade.

    Open a trade walletSee how it works

    What you get with T57

    1. SettlementWithout T57: Days, with FX feesWith T57: Near-instant
    2. OnboardingWithout T57: Separate bank checksWith T57: Verified once, used again
    3. ReconciliationWithout T57: ManualWith T57: Payments matched to the trade

    TodayWith T57

    Finance, escrow and insurance come from licensed partners.

    T57 solves slow, fragmented trade payments by giving members wallets in any currency and digital banking services from licensed partners, connected to every trade.

    The problem

    Money moves slower than the goods

    A food business that trades across borders may hold accounts in several banks and currencies, wait days for payments to clear and lose money on every conversion. Payments sit in one system, contracts in another and invoices in a third, so finance teams spend hours matching them. For smaller exporters, opening a foreign-currency account can take weeks, and some are refused altogether.

    How it works

    Open a wallet → Pay and get paid → Reconcile automatically

    1. 01

      Open a wallet

      Verified members open multi-currency wallets with T57's licensed digital banking partners, using the verification already done for their T57 Passport.

    2. 02

      Pay and get paid

      Send and receive trade payments, including escrow releases and finance proceeds, in the currencies you trade in.

    3. 03

      Reconcile automatically

      Every payment is linked to its contract, invoice and delivery on the trade record.

    What makes it different

    Built for trust, not just listings

    Verified once, used againYour T57 Passport helps speed up onboarding with banking partners, so you do not start from scratch.
    Near-instant settlementPayments between members' wallets settle in near real time, rather than over days.
    Payments that know the tradeEach payment is tied to the trade record, so reconciliation, audit and finance all use the same data.

    Use case · Illustrative example

    Chennai seafood exporter gets paid faster by a Dubai buyer

    A Chennai frozen seafood exporter sells to a verified Dubai distributor every month. Both hold multi-currency wallets through T57's digital banking partner. When the distributor confirms delivery, escrow releases payment straight into the exporter's wallet, and it settles in near real time. The exporter converts what it needs to rupees, keeps dirhams for its next freight payment, and every transaction is already matched to its invoice.

    Why T57

    We believe that getting paid for food should be as fast as the food needs to move.

    Licensed partners

    Wallets, accounts and digital banking services are provided by licensed banks and payment institutions. T57 does not hold client funds.

    One record for money and goods

    Payments sit on the same trade record as contracts and deliveries, which makes finance, audit and compliance simpler.

    FAQ

    Common questions

    Is T57 a bank?

    No. Digital banking services on T57 are provided by licensed partners. T57 connects them to your verified profile and trade record.

    Which currencies can I hold?

    Any currency your trade needs. T57's banking partners hold, convert and settle across currencies, so you can pay suppliers and get paid by buyers in their own currency.

    Why T57 Document Management & Audit TrailHow it worksWhat's differentUse caseFAQ

    WHY T57 · GOVERN AND CLOSE

    Every document of a trade, on one record.

    Every document, approval and milestone of a trade, on one tamper-evident record.

    See it in a demoSee how it works

    What you get with T57

    1. DocumentsWithout T57: Retyped, many versionsWith T57: Entered once
    2. ApprovalsWithout T57: Lost in email threadsWith T57: On one record
    3. AuditWithout T57: Hard to proveWith T57: Tamper-evident trail

    TodayWith T57

    Finance, escrow and insurance come from licensed partners.

    T57 solves the scattered, unverifiable paperwork of food trade by keeping every document and event on one trade record that every authorized party can trust.

    The problem

    Which version is the real one?

    A single food shipment can need dozens of documents: quotes, contracts, invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin, halal and phytosanitary certificates, inspection reports, bills of lading, insurance policies and customs declarations. They arrive by email, courier and messaging apps, in different versions, from different parties. When something goes wrong, nobody can say which version is real. Errors cause delays at port, rejected LC presentations, and lenders and auditors who cannot trust the paperwork.

    How it works

    Generate → Collect and check → Record

    1. 01

      Generate

      Core documents such as the contract and invoice are generated from the accepted quote, so the data is entered once.

    2. 02

      Collect and check

      Partner documents, such as inspection reports and certificates, are added to the trade record and checked for completeness and consistency.

    3. 03

      Record

      Every document, approval and milestone is time-stamped and anchored on a tamper-evident ledger, creating a full audit trail.

    What makes it different

    Built for trust, not just listings

    Data entered onceDocuments generated from the quote carry the same product, price, quantity and terms, which cuts errors and discrepancies.
    One version of the truthEvery party with permission sees the same documents, with a full history of who added or approved what, and when.
    Tamper-evidentKey records are anchored on a blockchain ledger, so any change after the fact can be detected.

    Use case · Illustrative example

    Port Klang importer clears a shipment without a document dispute

    A Port Klang importer receives a shipment of Indian rice. The contract, invoice and packing list were all generated from the accepted quote on T57. The inspection report, certificate of origin and phytosanitary certificate were added by partners to the same record. The importer's bank, insurer and customs broker work from the same documents, so the LC presentation is accepted first time and the goods clear without a dispute over which version is correct.

    Why T57

    We believe that trust in a trade should rest on records everyone can check, not paper anyone can change.

    Built for audit and regulators

    A complete, time-stamped trail supports lenders, insurers, auditors and customs authorities, and makes paperless pre-clearance possible where authorities support it.

    AI advises, people decide

    AI reads and checks documents for missing fields and mismatches. People approve, and every adverse decision is reviewed by a person.

    FAQ

    Common questions

    Who can see my trade documents?

    Only the parties you authorize for that trade, such as your counterparty, lender, insurer or inspector. Access is recorded in the audit trail.

    Are documents stored on the blockchain?

    No. Documents are stored securely, and a digital fingerprint of each key record is anchored on the ledger. This proves the document has not changed without exposing its contents.

    Capabilities

    Every step of a food trade. One record.

    Run every part of a food trade, from first quote to final payment, on one record.

    Book a demoSee how it works

    What you get with T57

    1. ServicesWithout T57: Eight separate providersWith T57: One connected platform
    2. DetailsWithout T57: Retyped at every stepWith T57: Entered once, shared by all
    3. StatusWithout T57: Nobody sees the whole tradeWith T57: Every party sees the same facts

    TodayWith T57

    Finance, escrow and insurance come from licensed partners.

    T57 exists to replace the eight separate services a single food trade needs with one connected set of capabilities, all working from the same verified trade record.

    The problem

    Eight services, eight copies of the deal

    A single food trade still needs eight separate services. Someone has to find and check the counterparty, agree the price and terms, arrange finance, protect the payment, insure the cargo, inspect the goods, ship them and clear customs. Today each is bought separately, with its own paperwork and its own view of the deal. Details are retyped, documents drift out of line, and nobody sees the whole trade. That is why banks rejected 41% of SME trade finance applications in 2025 (ADB, January 2026), and why so many good food trades stall between agreement and delivery. The key challenges T57 addresses include:

    Disconnected services

    Finance, insurance, inspection and logistics providers each work from their own copy of the deal.

    Repeated work

    The same product, price and party details are typed again and again, and every retyping risks an error.

    No single view

    Buyers, sellers, lenders and regulators cannot see where a trade stands or trust that its records are complete.

    How T57 works for you

    Agree → Fund and protect → Deliver → Settle and close

    1. 01

      Agree

      Find verified counterparties, compare quotes and turn the accepted quote into a contract.

    2. 02

      Fund and protect

      Request finance, escrow, letters of credit and insurance or takaful from licensed partners using the same deal file.

    3. 03

      Deliver

      Book inspection, freight and customs through vetted partners and track every milestone.

    4. 04

      Settle and close

      Release payment on agreed milestones and keep a full, tamper-evident record of the trade.

    Explore

    Eight capability groups, one record

    01Trade ExecutionRFQs, the Virtual Trade Desk, contract farming, government tenders, traceability and AI-assisted orders by chat.02Trust and PaymentsEscrow and trade assurance, digital wallets and electronic letters of credit.03Banking and Money MovementDigital banking, accounts in any currency, remittance and digital-asset services.04Financing and CapitalTrade and supply chain finance, Shariah-compliant finance and tokenized asset-based funding.05Risk and ProtectionCargo and trade credit insurance, takaful and compliance screening.06Logistics and FulfilmentA connected logistics network, real-time shipment tracking and a customs and documentation hub.07Intelligence and DataA live food price index, AI negotiation support, forecasting and trade data services.08Agritech and SustainabilityAn equipment rental marketplace for farmers and cooperatives.

    Use case · Illustrative example

    Indian processor runs an export from quote to payment

    A rice processor in Haryana receives an RFQ from a verified Riyadh distributor. It quotes, the distributor accepts, and the contract is generated from the quote. The distributor's bank issues an electronic LC through T57, cargo insurance and pre-shipment inspection are booked from the same record, and a freight partner moves the goods to Jeddah with documents ready for customs. The processor tracks every step in one place and is paid on compliant presentation, without retyping a single detail.

    Why T57

    We believe that a food trade should be run as one connected process, not eight separate errands.

    Connected execution on one record

    Every capability reads from and writes to the same verified trade record, so documents match and every party sees the same facts.

    Institutional trust

    T57 works with the Islamic Organization for Food Security (IOFS) under a 10-year memorandum of understanding. Regulated services are provided by licensed banks, insurers and payment partners.

    FAQ

    Common questions

    Do I have to use every capability on every trade?

    No. Members choose the capabilities each trade needs. Because they share one record, adding a service later does not mean starting again.

    Who provides finance, payments and insurance?

    Licensed partners. T57 does not lend, hold client funds, own goods or provide transport. It provides the verification, workflow and trade record that connect these services.

    Can I use T57 for domestic trade as well as exports?

    Yes. T57 supports domestic wholesale to supermarkets, HoReCa and institutions, as well as cross-border trade.

    Capabilities · Trade Execution

    From first enquiry to delivered deal.

    Turn a food trade opportunity into an agreed, delivered and documented deal.

    Start a tradeSee how it works

    What you get with T57

    1. TermsWithout T57: Drift from enquiry to contractWith T57: Entered once, never drift
    2. SupplyWithout T57: Agreed on a handshakeWith T57: Locked in by contract
    3. OriginWithout T57: Hard to proveWith T57: Traced lot by lot

    TodayWith T57

    Finance, escrow and insurance come from licensed partners.

    T57 solves the gap between agreeing a food trade and actually delivering it, by carrying every request, quote, contract and order through to execution on one record.

    The problem

    Deals agreed in chats, run on spreadsheets

    Most food trades are agreed in conversations and then run on spreadsheets, emails and phone calls. Specifications change between the enquiry and the contract. Orders for the next season are made on a handshake. Public tenders arrive as long PDFs that smaller suppliers cannot easily answer. And when a buyer or regulator asks where a product came from, the answer is buried in paper. The key challenges T57 addresses include:

    Lost detail

    Specifications, prices and terms change or disappear between the first enquiry and the final contract.

    Uncertain supply

    Buyers cannot lock in future supply, and growers cannot plan or finance next season's crop.

    Weak proof of origin

    Buyers, insurers and regulators increasingly ask for traceability that most food SMEs cannot provide.

    How T57 works for you

    Request → Agree → Execute → Trace and close

    1. 01

      Request

      Start with an RFQ, a contract farming plan, a tender response or a simple chat message.

    2. 02

      Agree

      Compare verified responses and turn the accepted quote into a contract.

    3. 03

      Execute

      Connect finance, inspection, logistics and customs to the same trade record.

    4. 04

      Trace and close

      Record every milestone and the origin of every lot, from farm or factory to final buyer.

    Capabilities

    Trade execution capabilities

    01RFQ and Trade ExecutionStructured requests, comparable quotes from verified suppliers and contracts generated from the accepted quote.02Virtual Trade DeskAI matching, price data, contract preparation and compliance screening, with people making the decisions.03Contract FarmingForward agreements between buyers and growers or cooperatives, with inputs, quality standards and finance linked to the crop.04Government TendersFind, prepare and submit responses to public food procurement tenders as a verified supplier.05TraceabilityFollow every lot from origin through processing and shipment, on a tamper-evident record.06LLM-Based OrdersPlace and update orders in plain language through WhatsApp or chat, with AI turning messages into structured orders.

    Use case · Illustrative example

    Johor processor locks in supply and wins a hotel contract

    A food processor in Johor needs a steady supply of chillies and a new customer for its sauces. Through T57 it signs a contract farming agreement with a verified cooperative in Pahang, with quality standards and delivery dates agreed upfront. It answers an RFQ from a verified hotel group in Kuala Lumpur and wins. Each batch of sauce is traceable back to the cooperative's harvest, which the hotel group's food safety team can check on the trade record.

    Why T57

    We believe that what is agreed should be exactly what is delivered.

    One record from enquiry to delivery

    Every capability in Trade Execution reads from the same verified record, so details are entered once and never drift.

    AI advises, people decide

    AI suggests matches, reads tenders and turns messages into orders. People confirm every commitment.

    FAQ

    Common questions

    Can I use Trade Execution without finance or logistics?

    Yes. You can use RFQs, contracts and traceability on their own, and add finance, insurance or logistics to any trade later.

    Does T57 sell or buy the goods?

    No. T57 does not own goods. Members trade directly with each other on T57.

    Which products can I trade?

    Food across the whole chain: grown, raised and caught products, and processed, manufactured and branded goods.

    Capabilities · Trade Execution · RFQ

    One request. Like-for-like quotes.

    Send one structured request, compare verified quotes and execute the deal you choose.

    Post your first RFQSee how it works

    What you get with T57

    1. RequestsWithout T57: Described differently each timeWith T57: One structured RFQ
    2. QuotesWithout T57: Mixed units and termsWith T57: Normalized, side by side
    3. ContractWithout T57: Retyped by handWith T57: Generated from the quote

    TodayWith T57

    Finance, escrow and insurance come from licensed partners.

    T57 solves the slow, inconsistent way food is sourced and quoted, for buyers who need reliable supply and sellers who want serious, verified enquiries.

    The problem

    Quotes you cannot compare

    Food sourcing still runs on emails, calls and messaging apps. A buyer describes what it needs differently to each supplier, and quotes come back in different units, currencies and Incoterms. Comparing them takes days, and the agreed terms are then retyped into a contract and purchase order, often with errors. Sellers, meanwhile, spend hours answering enquiries from buyers they cannot check. The key challenges T57 addresses include:

    Quotes you cannot compare

    Different formats, units and terms make it hard to see which offer is truly best.

    Unverified parties

    Buyers and sellers often cannot confirm who is on the other side, or whether they are the producer or an intermediary.

    Errors between quote and contract

    Retyping terms into contracts and orders creates mismatches that surface at the bank, the port or the warehouse.

    How T57 works for you

    Create the RFQ → Invite and receive bids → Compare and award → Execute

    1. 01

      Create the RFQ

      Set product, grade, specifications, quantity, packaging, Incoterms, destination, delivery window and payment preference.

    2. 02

      Invite and receive bids

      T57 matches the request to verified suppliers, and you can invite your own. Suppliers respond in the same structure.

    3. 03

      Compare and award

      Review bids side by side against recent price data, ask clarifying questions and accept the best offer.

    4. 04

      Execute

      The contract is generated from the accepted quote, and finance, inspection, logistics and payment are connected to the same trade record.

    Features

    12 features, one trade record

    Structured RFQ builderGuided fields for specifications, quantities, packaging, Incoterms and certifications. For buyers, this means suppliers quote exactly what you need.
    Product templatesReady-made specifications for common products such as rice, dates, poultry, spices and edible oils. For first-time buyers, this saves time and avoids gaps.
    AI supplier matchingRanks verified suppliers by product, capacity, origin and track record. For buyers, this widens choice beyond the usual contacts.
    Private invitationsInvite existing suppliers to bid alongside matched ones. For established buyers, this keeps trusted relationships in the process.
    Verified bidders onlyEvery bidder holds a T57 Passport and a role label. For buyers, this shows who controls the goods before you read a price.
    Side-by-side comparisonBids are normalized by unit, currency and Incoterm. For procurement teams, this means like-for-like decisions.
    Price benchmarkingEach bid is shown against recent market price data. For buyers and sellers, this supports fair pricing.
    Clarification threadQuestions and answers are attached to the RFQ, not lost in email. For both sides, this keeps a record of what was agreed.
    Confidential biddingEach bid is visible only to the buyer. For sellers, this protects pricing.
    Contract from quoteThe accepted bid becomes the contract and purchase order automatically. For legal and finance teams, this removes retyping errors.
    Repeat and scheduled ordersReuse an RFQ or set recurring orders for regular supply. For supermarkets and HoReCa, this simplifies routine buying.
    Connected executionFinance, escrow, LCs, insurance, inspection and logistics start from the same record. For everyone, this means one place to run the trade.

    Use case · Illustrative example

    Riyadh supermarket chain sources local dairy and imported rice in one place

    A Riyadh supermarket chain uses T57 for both domestic and imported supply. It sets a recurring RFQ for fresh laban and yoghurt, which verified Saudi dairies bid on each month, and a quarterly RFQ for basmati rice, which draws bids from verified processors in India and Pakistan. The category team compares each round against price data, awards contracts in a few clicks, and pays local suppliers through escrow and the rice exporter through an LC, all from the same records.

    Why T57

    We believe that every food business deserves a fair, transparent way to buy and sell.

    Verified from the first message

    T57 is a members-only trade club. Every bidder has passed business, identity and compliance checks and carries a role label.

    AI advises, people decide

    AI suggests suppliers and flags unusual bids. Buyers decide who wins.

    FAQ

    Common questions

    How long does an RFQ stay open?

    The buyer sets the deadline. Bids received after it closes are not shown unless the buyer reopens the RFQ.

    Can I negotiate after receiving bids?

    Yes. You can ask clarifying questions or request a revised bid from any supplier before you award the contract.

    Can sellers create offers without an RFQ?

    Yes. Verified sellers can publish product listings and wholesale terms that buyers can respond to directly.

    Capabilities · Trade Execution · Virtual Trade Desk

    A trading house desk, without the headcount.

    Give your business the trade desk of a global trading house, without hiring one.

    Book a Trade Desk demoSee how it works

    What you get with T57

    1. MatchingWithout T57: A few known contactsWith T57: Ranked, verified counterparties
    2. ScreeningWithout T57: Skipped or lateWith T57: Every party, before the deal
    3. PaperworkWithout T57: InconsistentWith T57: Prepared and checked for you

    TodayWith T57

    Finance, escrow and insurance come from licensed partners.

    T57 solves the lack of trade expertise and tools in food SMEs by giving every member an AI-powered trade desk for matching, pricing, contracts and compliance, with people making every decision.

    The problem

    One or two people doing a whole desk's work

    Big trading houses have desks of specialists who source counterparties, track prices, draft contracts, check documents and screen every party for sanctions. Most food SMEs have one or two people doing all of this alongside everything else. The result is slower deals, missed opportunities and costly mistakes, such as a contract that does not match the LC or a counterparty that should never have been approved. The key challenges T57 addresses include:

    Too few hands

    Small teams cannot source, price, draft and check every deal properly.

    Compliance exposure

    Missing a sanctions hit or a document gap can stop a shipment or a payment and damage a business's reputation with its bank.

    Inconsistent paperwork

    Contracts and documents prepared by hand often disagree with each other.

    How T57 works for you

    Open the desk → Find and price → Prepare and check → Decide and escalate

    1. 01

      Open the desk

      Every verified member gets the Trade Desk as part of membership.

    2. 02

      Find and price

      The desk suggests verified counterparties and shows recent prices for the products and corridors you trade.

    3. 03

      Prepare and check

      It drafts the contract from the accepted quote, screens every party and checks documents for gaps and mismatches.

    4. 04

      Decide and escalate

      You make every decision. Cases that need a human review go to T57's trade desk team.

    Features

    10 features, one trade record

    Counterparty matchingRanks verified buyers and sellers by product, volume, corridor and track record. For SMEs, this replaces cold calling.
    Corridor viewShows which markets are buying and selling your product, and at what volumes. For exporters, this points to new markets.
    Price dataRecent market and platform prices by product and origin. For traders, this supports confident quotes and counter-offers.
    Quote assistantHelps prepare a quote from your costs, target margin and current prices. For sellers, this speeds up responses.
    Contract from quoteDrafts the contract from the accepted quote, with standard food trade clauses. For both sides, this removes retyping.
    Sanctions and watchlist screeningScreens every counterparty, owner and vessel before a deal moves on. For members, this protects their banking relationships.
    Document extractionReads uploaded documents such as certificates and invoices and pulls out key data. For operations teams, this cuts manual entry.
    Discrepancy checksCompares documents against the contract and LC terms and flags mismatches. For exporters, this reduces rejected presentations.
    Deal checklistLists what each trade still needs, from certificates to insurance. For first-time exporters, this means nothing is forgotten.
    Human reviewT57's trade desk team reviews flagged cases, and every adverse decision is reviewed by a person. For members, this means AI never has the final word.

    Use case · Illustrative example

    Izmir dried fruit exporter avoids a costly mismatch

    A dried apricot exporter in Izmir agrees to sell to a verified buyer in Doha. The Trade Desk drafts the contract from the accepted quote and screens the buyer and its owners. When the exporter uploads its documents, the desk flags that the packing list shows a different net weight from the contract. The exporter corrects it before presenting documents under the LC, and payment arrives on time instead of being held for a discrepancy.

    Why T57

    We believe that expertise should not depend on the size of your business.

    AI advises, people decide

    The Trade Desk suggests, drafts and checks. You decide, and T57's team reviews flagged cases.

    Compliance built in

    Every counterparty is screened before you commit, which protects you, your bank and your buyers.

    FAQ

    Common questions

    Is the Trade Desk included in membership?

    Yes. Every verified member can use the Trade Desk. Higher membership tiers include deeper data and higher usage.

    Does the Trade Desk make decisions for me?

    No. It provides suggestions, drafts and checks. You make every commercial decision.

    What happens when the Trade Desk flags a problem?

    You see the issue and a suggested fix. If the issue concerns compliance or verification, it goes to T57's team for human review.

    Capabilities · Trade Execution · Contract Farming

    Agree next season's crop, today.

    Agree next season's crop today, with buyers, growers and finance on one record.

    Set up a contract farming planSee how it works

    What you get with T57

    1. GrowersWithout T57: No guaranteed marketWith T57: A buyer before planting
    2. BuyersWithout T57: Unreliable supplyWith T57: Supply locked in by contract
    3. SeasonWithout T57: No finance for inputsWith T57: Input finance against the contract

    TodayWith T57

    Finance, escrow and insurance come from licensed partners.

    T57 solves the uncertainty that keeps farmers from planning and buyers from securing supply, by putting forward agreements, quality standards and crop finance on one verified record.

    The problem

    Growers plant blind, buyers hope for supply

    Small farms produce around a third of the world's food (FAO, 2021), yet most smallholders plant without knowing who will buy their crop or at what price. Buyers, from processors to supermarket chains, struggle to secure steady volumes of the right quality. Informal forward deals break down when prices move, and lenders rarely finance a crop that has no confirmed buyer. The key challenges T57 addresses include:

    No guaranteed market

    Farmers take all the price and sales risk, which discourages investment in quality and yield.

    Unreliable supply

    Processors and retailers cannot count on consistent volumes, grades or delivery dates.

    No finance for the season

    Without a confirmed buyer, growers cannot borrow for seeds, fertilizer and labor.

    How T57 works for you

    Set the plan → Agree with growers → Fund and support → Harvest and settle

    1. 01

      Set the plan

      The buyer sets crop, variety, volume, quality standards, price or price formula and delivery schedule.

    2. 02

      Agree with growers

      Verified farmers, cooperatives and producer organizations accept the plan, and the forward contract is generated on T57.

    3. 03

      Fund and support

      Growers can request input finance from licensed lenders against the contract, and buyers can supply inputs or advice through partners.

    4. 04

      Harvest and settle

      Deliveries are inspected and recorded against the contract, and payment is released on agreed milestones.

    Features

    11 features, one trade record

    Forward contractsFixed-price, minimum-price or formula-based agreements for future harvests. For farmers, this gives a guaranteed market.
    Quality specificationsGrades, residue limits and certifications agreed upfront. For processors, this means fewer rejected loads.
    Cooperative contractingOne agreement can cover many members of a cooperative or producer organization. For smallholders, this adds bargaining power.
    Input finance against the contractGrowers request finance from licensed lenders, with the contract as evidence of a confirmed buyer. For farmers, this unlocks working capital for the season.
    Input supplyBuyers or partners can provide seeds, fertilizer or equipment, recorded against the contract. For buyers, this protects quality from the start.
    Crop and yield forecastingAI estimates expected volumes from planting data, weather and history. For buyers, this supports earlier planning.
    Expert adviceAccess to agronomists and advisers through partners. For growers, this helps meet the agreed standards.
    Milestone trackingPlanting, growth checks, harvest and delivery are recorded on the trade record. For both sides, this shows progress at a glance.
    Inspection at deliveryIndependent checks against the agreed specifications. For both sides, this settles quality fairly.
    Escrow and milestone paymentsPayment released on delivery and acceptance through licensed partners. For farmers, this means getting paid on time.
    TraceabilityEvery lot is linked to the farm and contract it came from. For brands and retailers, this proves origin.

    Use case · Illustrative example

    Maharashtra onion cooperative secures a Gulf buyer for the season

    A farmer producer organization in Nashik, Maharashtra, agrees a seasonal contract on T57 with a verified Dubai importer for export-grade onions, with a minimum price and delivery schedule. Using the contract as evidence, the cooperative obtains input finance from a licensed lender for its members. Growth checks are logged during the season. At harvest, an inspection partner confirms grade at the packhouse, and payment for each shipment is released through escrow when it is accepted.

    Why T57

    We believe that the people who grow food should be able to plan, invest and get paid fairly.

    Fair for both sides

    Terms, quality checks and payments are recorded on one record that farmers and buyers can both see.

    AI advises, people decide

    AI forecasts yields and flags risks. Farmers and buyers decide, and any adverse decision about a member is reviewed by a person.

    FAQ

    Common questions

    Can individual smallholders use contract farming on T57?

    Yes, usually through a cooperative or producer organization that holds the T57 membership and signs on behalf of its members.

    What happens if prices change during the season?

    It depends on the contract. Fixed-price, minimum-price and formula-based agreements each handle price movements differently, and the terms are agreed upfront.

    Does T57 provide the inputs or finance?

    No. Inputs come from buyers or partners, and finance comes from licensed lenders. T57 provides the contract, records and workflow.
